title: Meow feature rows
description: A titled run of alternating feature rows: indented text (a 28px title, a paragraph, two dotted bullet lines and an arrow link that fades on hover) beside a large pale-grey media panel, swapping sides row by row. On phones every row is panel first, then a smaller 18px title and the text.
notes: media: each panel (≈1.49 aspect) is a grey placeholder until filled
the first row has its text on the left
